whatAYeaDid: Directed Civic Administration to restart the Wonderland Road corridor Environmental Assessment (Southdale Road to Fanshawe Park Road) to build six general-purpose through lanes, with a long-term option to convert to Bus Rapid Transit, and to update the Mobility Master Plan maps accordingly.
quote: the Civic Administration BE DIRECTED to re-start the Discover Wonderland Road Environmental Assessment, with expanded limits from Southdale Road to Fanshawe Park Road, in order to construct six general purpose, through lanes along the corridor with a long-term build-and-convert option to Bus Rapid Transit and to modify the MMP maps accordingly
verifierNote: Same item, index 12 (Motion Passed 9-6, matches manifest): 'the Civic Administration BE DIRECTED to re-start the...Environmental Assessment...in order to construct six general purpose, through lanes along the corridor with a long-term build-and-convert option to Bus Rapid Transit.' Verbatim and operative -- the primary, near-term commitment is building six general-purpose (car) through lanes, with BRT conversion only a long-term 'option,' not a commitment. This is unambiguously a road-widening/infrastructure-expansion vote (the tracked axis's own label is 'expanded transit OR road service/infrastructure,' bundling both modes), so expansive is confirmed as coded -- but flagging for the record that a naive reader could mistake this axis label for 'supported transit specifically,' when the substance is road-capacity expansion with only an optional future transit conversion. As long as downstream display uses the literal axisLabel text this isn't a false statement, just a nuance worth knowing.
